selection_rationale: Candidate a1 directly addresses verifier+LLM end-to-end safety and rollback—high venue relevance, clear falsifiable hypotheses, feasible compute budget, explicit primary outcomes, and a critic "pass" verdict. It yields actionable, measurable operational metrics (unsafe-enactment rate, rollback success) and is implementable within constraints.
unresolved_uncertainties: Emulator fidelity versus real production networks (external validity).
Verifier false negatives/positives and their impact on measured effectiveness.
Prompt sensitivity and single-hosted-LLM generality (robustness across models/prompts).
Sample size/power adequacy for subgroup analyses (120 tasks may be marginal).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact verifier implementation (e.g., Batfish variant) and precisely map invariants to emulator artifacts and checks.
Add prompt-sensitivity and seed-robustness probes (small deterministic perturbation set) and include their logging policy.
Pre-register a power calculation justifying 120 tasks or increase task count for key strata (ambiguity/complexity levels).
Include at least one secondary LLM (or an open-checkpoint baseline) for robustness ablation and predefine provider-denial/API-failure handling and logging.
